title: BR10 · Returning guests (Inside Airbnb)
description: All rates use guests who wrote reviews. The dashboard reads reporting marts and does not depend on the time picker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT guests AS `Guests`, repeat_rate_pct AS `% returning (at least two trips)`,
       multi_city_pct AS `% visiting at least two destinations`, median_days_to_return AS `Median days to second trip`
FROM tourism.mart_br10_city_overview WHERE city_id = 'ALL'

panels.title: % of guests returning to the same destination

targets.rawSql:
SELECT city_name, repeat_rate_pct AS `% returning`, multi_city_pct AS `% visiting another destination`
FROM tourism.mart_br10_city_overview WHERE city_id != 'ALL' ORDER BY repeat_rate_pct DESC
SELECT rfm_segment, guests FROM tourism.mart_br10_rfm_segment ORDER BY guests DESC

panels.title: Cohort matrix — cumulative % returned after N months

targets.rawSql:
SELECT formatDateTime(cohort_month, '%Y-%m') AS cohort, any(cohort_size) AS size,
  maxIf(cumulative_return_pct, month_offset = 1)  AS m1,
  maxIf(cumulative_return_pct, month_offset = 3)  AS m3,
  maxIf(cumulative_return_pct, month_offset = 6)  AS m6,
  maxIf(cumulative_return_pct, month_offset = 9)  AS m9,
  maxIf(cumulative_return_pct, month_offset = 12) AS m12,
  maxIf(cumulative_return_pct, month_offset = 18) AS m18,
  maxIf(cumulative_return_pct, month_offset = 24) AS m24
FROM tourism.mart_br10_cohort GROUP BY cohort_month ORDER BY cohort_month

panels.title: % of yearly guests who stayed in an earlier year

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(makeDate(year, 1, 1)) AS time, city_id, returning_pct
FROM tourism.mart_br10_yearly WHERE year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2025 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Where guests go next (previous trip → next trip)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT from_city AS `From`, to_city AS `To`, guests AS `Guests`, transitions AS `Transitions`
FROM tourism.mart_br10_city_flow ORDER BY guests DESC LIMIT 36
